title: After School Program Information Sheet
subtitle: Capture activity block, homework period, snack service, and dismissal roster; confirm late pickup and family communication.
description: After School Program records activity block, homework period, snack service, dismissal roster, late pickup, and family communication. After School Program evidence stays linked.
use_case: Use this after school program controlled information handoff when staff must document activity block and homework period. Reconcile snack service, dismissal roster, late pickup, and family communication before the after school program handoff. Useful evidence includes the activity calendar, homework plan, snack roster, dismissal sheet, family message, and end-of-day pickup log. Ask the assigned after school program reviewer to confirm activity block against the organization's policy.
